description.zh: 基于德波诺「六顶思考帽」的决策推演工作台。蓝帽编排，白绿黄黑红五帽递进审议，最后由蓝帽收束决策报告。全程串行、本地留档、可导出 Markdown。
description.en: Decision workbench based on Six Thinking Hats. Deliberate across facts, ideas, value, risks, and intuition, synthesized into a final decision report.

releaseNotes.zh: v1.0.4: 新增【穿透追问·深度研讨室】，将议题与六顶帽子全部产出整体注入上下文，支持持续多轮追问并随档案持久化；同时重写 Markdown 渲染引擎，新增表格、1~6级标题、引用块、嵌套列表、任务清单、删除线与超链接支持。
releaseNotes.en: v1.0.4: Added a Follow-Up Deep Inquiry Room injecting the full six-hat deliberation as dialogue context for multi-turn follow-ups, plus a rebuilt Markdown engine (tables, H1-H6, quotes, nested lists, task lists, links).
